scientific_integrity: The existing symmetric-map coefficients and established spectral method are explicitly credited. Exact symbolic polynomial identities and exact rational finite-horizon tests corroborate a separate analytic spectral proof. The result has not received an independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed parameter 0<a<1, Lebesgue stationary law, affine position observable and cumulants of orders 2 through 4 only. No parameter-uniform endpoint asymptotics, full large-deviation rate, or general observable theorem. Symmetric-case coefficients and transfer-operator technique previously established by Smith; publication-priority checks are incomplete.
title: Universal third- and fourth-cumulant geometry for skew tent trajectories
